{{Current events|year=2018|month=07|day=9|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Japan floods]]
**The death toll from heavy rains in [[Japan]] rises to 126, with over 86 people still reported missing. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/07/09/national/west-japan-downpours-flooding-far-leave-88-dead-50-missing/ (''Japan Today'')]
*[[Tham Luang cave rescue]]
**Divers in [[Thailand]] rescue four more boys from the cave [[Tham Luang Nang Non]] bringing the total to 8 rescued. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/rescue-effort-restarts-final-boys-coach-trapped-cave/story?id=56450198 (ABC News)]
*About 50 students are poisoned by inhaling a toxic gas, due to an explosion near their school of the locality of Chosica, in Lima, Peru. Spokespeople from local municipality say that this poisoning is due to the leakage of gas from a chlorine cylinder, although the place where the explosion began and the origin of the product has yet to be determined. [https://elcomercio.pe/lima/seguridad/chosica-50-escolares-intoxicados-fuga-gas-noticia-534370?foto=3 (''El Comercio'')] [https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/1275156-chosica-evacuan-50-escolares-fuga-gas-toxico (''La República'')]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**The number of homes destroyed by lava from the latest eruption reaches 700. [https://www.bizjournals.com/pacific/news/2018/07/09/number-of-homes-destroyed-by-kilauea-eruption.html (The Business Journals)]
;International relations
*[[2018 Eritrea–Ethiopia summit]]
**Leaders from [[Eritrea]] and [[Ethiopia]] officially declare an end to their countries' 20-year [[Eritrean–Ethiopian border conflict|border conflict]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/ethiopia-eritrea-officially-end-war/a-44585296 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Sanctions against Iran]], [[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury|U.S. Treasury Department]] announces [[Sanctions against Iran|sanctions]] for a Malaysia-based sales agent for [[Mahan Air]] in connection with [[Iran]]'s alleged support for international terrorism. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-sanctions-malaysia/u-s-sanctions-malaysia-based-agent-for-irans-mahan-air-idUSKBN1JZ2D8 (Reuters)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Inn Din massacre#Arrest of Reuters journalists|Inn Din massacre § Arrest of Reuters journalists]]
**A court in [[Myanmar]] charges two [[Reuters]] journalists with obtaining secret state documents in violation of the [[British rule in Burma|colonial-era]] ''Official Secrets Act'', taking the landmark press freedom case to trial after a period of preliminary hearings that lasted six months. The two journalists were investigating mass graves in the village of [[Inn Din]] in northern [[Rakhine State]] prior to their arrest and imprisonment on 12 December 2017. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-journalists-ruling/myanmar-court-presses-secrets-act-charges-against-reuters-reporters-idUSKBN1JZ095 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/07/myanmar-charges-reuters-reporters-official-secrets-act-180709042144322.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**[[Eugene Gu]], a doctor famous for successfully suing President [[Donald Trump]] for blocking him on [[Twitter]], has been accused of sexual assault by a woman who says she’s his ex. [https://www.dailydot.com/irl/eugene-gu-accused-sexual-assault/ (Daily Dot)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2017–18 Iranian protests]], [[Human rights in Iran]]
**[[Iran]]ian women post videos of themselves dancing to protest the arrest of [[Instagram]] blogger [[Maedeh Hojabri]]. [http://time.com/5332944/iran-arrest-teenage-dancer-maedeh-hojabri/ (''Time'')]
*[[2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**[[Prime Minister of Spain|Spanish Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez (politician)|Pedro Sánchez]] and [[President of the Generalitat of Catalonia]], [[Quim Torra]], meet officially in [[Palace of Moncloa|Moncloa]]. It is the first time since the beginning of the crisis that a Spanish Prime Minister and a Catalan President meet. [https://elpais.com/elpais/2018/07/09/inenglish/1531122292_338964.html (''El País'')]
*[[Politics of the United Kingdom]]
**[[Boris Johnson]] resigns as the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Secretary of State for Foreign and Commonwealth Affairs]] amid disagreements with Prime Minister [[Theresa May]] over [[Brexit negotiations]]. Johnson is the second member of [[Second May ministry|May's cabinet]] to resign in two days. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-44770847 (BBC)]
*[[Kentucky gubernatorial election, 2019]]
**[[Attorney General of Kentucky|Kentucky Attorney General]] [[Andy Beshear]] announces that he will run for [[Governor of Kentucky|Kentucky Governor]] in 2019. [https://www.courier-journal.com/story/news/politics/2018/07/09/andy-beshear-run-kentucky-governor-2019/767093002/ (''Courier Journal'')]
*[[Brett Kavanaugh Supreme Court nomination]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] nominates [[Brett Kavanaugh]] to the [[U.S. Supreme Court]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-trump/trump-set-to-announce-hotly-anticipated-u-s-supreme-court-pick-idUSKBN1JZ25A (Reuters)]

;Sports
*Former [[NFL]] cornerback [[Brandon Browner]] is arrested after allegedly breaking into a home of an ex-girlfriend who has a restraining order against him. [https://www.upi.com/Sports_News/NFL/2018/07/09/Police-Former-NFL-CB-Brandon-Browner-arrested-threatened-ex-girlfriend/5831531163446/ (UPI)]
